title: fix(console): the record drawer's bar opens the assistant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PUdqHFZRxJnzcBfALr6whd)_

Fixes #36998

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在列表里从侧边抽屉打开一条记录时，抽屉顶栏多了一个「AI 助手」按钮；点它会把这条记录打开成完整页面，并在旁边打开 AI 助手。以前抽屉盖住了右上角的助手按钮，打不开。
- 属于「记录范围 AI 问询」专题，解决「最想问这条记录时反而打不开助手」的问题。
- 出错的话只是抽屉里少一个或多一个按钮，不碰数据，可直接撤回；环境没有 AI 时不显示。
- 无。

## What changes

The record side drawer is a `fixed z-50` card 8 px from the viewport's top and right edges, over the right end of the console's top bar, where the assistant's one standing entry (the robot, `AssistantTopBarButton`) sits, and over the assistant's own drawer. On the data page (`ObjectDataPage`) the drawer is also the modal sheet, so nothing outside it is reachable. While a record was open in the drawer the assistant could not be opened.

- Both record drawers draw an 「AI Assistant」 control in their bar, through the bar's existing `toggles` slot of `NavigationOverlay`; no new prop, component or hook:
  - `RecordStackDrawer` (`recordDrawerStack.tsx`): the object list's drawer and a record page's drawer. Drawn beside the record's ⊟ in the record row.
  - `ObjectDataPage`'s drawer (one-row bar): drawn beside ⤢ 「Open as full page」.
- Drawn under the same gate as the robot: `useChatDockControl()` is non-null only under a layout hosting the assistant (`ConsoleLayout`, `HomeLayout`), and those hand a handle only while `useAiSurfaceEnabled().enabled`, the gate `AppHeader` draws the robot behind. No handle, no control. `RecordStackDrawer` also needs its page hop (`onOpenAsPage`); without one it draws none.
- A click does what the card prescribes: the record's page hop (the same one ⤢ takes, so the page keeps the list as its origin), then `ChatDockControl.open()` with no target, so the assistant opens on whatever it shows and reads the record page in view.
- The label is the robot's own key, `topbar.aiAssistant`, already in all ten locales: no new translation key, so the published language pack is unchanged (`Clause-②: no`).

Scope note: the card names `ObjectDataPage`; the object list (`ObjectView`) opens its drawer through `RecordStackDrawer`, which covers the robot the same way (non-modal, but the card sits over the top bar's right end), so it carries the same control. Same defect, same fix, both in the card's title.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/recordDrawerAssistant-36998.test.tsx` (real `RecordStackDrawer` + `NavigationOverlay`): handle present ⇒ the bar draws 「AI Assistant」 and a click calls the page hop, then `open()`; no handle ⇒ no control (⤢ still drawn); no page hop ⇒ no control.
- `ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx` gains a `objectstack#36998` block (real `ObjectDataPage`, grid and drawer): handle present ⇒ a click lands on `/apps/sales/demo_account/record/a2` with the data page as origin, `open()` called once, drawer gone; no handle ⇒ no control.
- Run at `aeef0e2f`, from `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run` on the two files above plus `recordDrawerStack-26679.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.recordDrawer-27545.test.tsx` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 41 passed (41)`.
- Ablation, one per gate (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob each time):
  - `recordDrawerStack.tsx` `dock && pane ?` → `pane ?`: `without the assistant (no dock handle), no entry is drawn` goes red (1 failed, 2 passed).
  - `ObjectDataPage.tsx` `openedRecordId && dock ?` → `openedRecordId ?`: `without the assistant (no dock handle), the drawer draws no entry` goes red.

## Acceptance notes

- None filed.

## Verification

- Browser measurement (card step 1), at `aeef0e2f`: showcase app (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`) with the `ui/` console served live by Vite, Chromium 1440×900, `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` answered with one active `ask` agent (the dev server serves none, so the assistant is otherwise hidden). The robot's own hit test (`elementFromPoint` at its centre, plus a trial click):

  | Drawer | Assistant drawer | Robot (the one entry) | Assistant drawer itself | New entry in the drawer bar |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | object list (`?recordId=`) | closed | covered: the point lands in the drawer card, trial click intercepted | n/a | drawn |
  | object list | open | visible (the rail moved it left), but it only closes the assistant | covered: its composer's centre lands in the drawer card | drawn |
  | data page (`/data?recordId=`) | closed | covered (modal sheet), trial click intercepted | n/a | drawn |
  | data page | open | covered (modal sheet) | covered | drawn |

  So the card's premise holds in all four states: the assistant cannot be used while a record drawer is open.
- After, clicking the bar's 「AI Assistant」 from each drawer: lands on `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_account/record/ID`, the drawer is gone, the robot reads `aria-pressed="true"`, the composer textarea takes focus (`document.activeElement` = `TEXTAREA`), and its context chip reads the record's object. Same result from both drawers.
- Type-check: declared to CI. Locally `tsc` reads `@object-ui/*` from `dist`, which is not built in this container, so the local run answers module-not-found for every import; no error names a line this PR adds.

Read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` (the `assistantEntry` block), then `ObjectDataPage.tsx` (`openDrawerRecordWithAssistant`).

Two-minute check: in a console with the assistant, open a record with the name cell's 「Open in side panel」 icon, click the robot icon in the drawer's bar; the record page opens with the assistant drawer open beside it.
